name: NodexM copy-inflation question set
note: Questions about recent, widely reported facts, where news is often syndicated from wires or press releases. Used to measure how often counting sites would overstate agreement.
questions: How much did OpenAI raise in its most recent funding round, and at what valuation?
What did the US Federal Reserve decide on interest rates at its most recent meeting?
What is the latest UK consumer price inflation rate?
When do the EU AI Act obligations for general-purpose AI models apply?
What were Nvidia's total revenue and data centre revenue in its latest reported quarter?
What is India's latest quarterly GDP growth rate?
How many measles cases were reported worldwide in 2024?
What does the latest UNEP Emissions Gap Report project for global warming this century?
What was the average price of lithium-ion battery packs in 2025?
How many jobs has Amazon cut in its 2025 and 2026 layoffs?
How much did global electric car sales grow in 2025?
What is the maximum fine under the EU AI Act for prohibited AI practices?
